item.title: Polson Rural Fire works to rescue dogs from Flathead Lake
item.description: A rescue on Flathead Lake Monday morning ended in success when two dogs safely returned to shore after being stuck on the ice and open water in Polson.

item.title: Two men accused of fentanyl distribution in Montana were arrested over the weekend
item.description: According to the FBI, Joshua Stephen Roybal, 35, and Patrick William Allen, 54, were arrested on separate, unrelated federal complaints. Roybal is from Kalispell and Allen is from Spokane.

item.title: Missoula officials provide information on immigration enforcement involvement
item.description: On Monday night, City of Missoula leadership addressed the shooting that occurred on Saturday in Minneapolis, providing information on the city's stance.
